summary: TOC's second In Focus session paired Devesh Lahoti (Futurowise) and Himansshu Jainn (The Student Scoop). Lahoti described Futurowise's 2-4 week, professor/industry-expert-led online courses (Data Science, Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI, Money & Investing, Entrepreneurship) that end in a published project and certificate. Jainn described The Student Scoop's 5-stage 'Academic Readiness Engine' (Diagnose, Map, Teach, Practice, Report) for IBDP/IGCSE/A-Level students, and noted that TSS mentors go through a mandatory 7-day pedagogical training program before teaching any class.
keyInsights: Futurowise runs 2-4 week courses led by university professors/industry experts, ending in a published project + certificate.
The Student Scoop's 5-stage model: Diagnose -> Map -> Teach -> Practice -> Report.
TSS mentors undergo a mandatory 7-day pedagogical training program before teaching.
